HanbokMatcher.title: Build a practical Hanbok direction
HanbokMatcher.intro: Pick what matters most to you. Your explicit choices always outrank any market default.
HanbokMatcher.colorHelp: Use your Personal Color result if you have one, or simply choose the palette you like.
HanbokMatcher.moodHelp: Choose the look you want, not what we assume from your language or nationality.
HanbokMatcher.comfortHelp: A palace outfit should still work for your rental time and walking plan.

elegant.name: Classic palace elegance
elegant.reason: Favor clean traditional lines and restrained contrast so the outfit works naturally with palace architecture.

royal.name: Structured royal statement
royal.reason: Favor stronger contrast and more formal visual weight for a dramatic palace-photo direction.

romantic.name: Soft romantic Hanbok
romantic.reason: Favor gentler contrast, graceful layers and a softer visual rhythm for daylight photos.

minimal.name: Modern minimal Hanbok
minimal.reason: Favor a quieter two-color story and less visual ornament for a clean contemporary direction.

kdrama.name: K-drama inspired look
kdrama.reason: Favor a recognizable cinematic silhouette while keeping the final rental choice practical for the day.

comfortNotes.walking: Prioritize lighter layers, manageable volume and easy movement before decorative detail.
comfortNotes.balanced: Keep enough structure for photos while avoiding volume or accessories that make a longer walk inconvenient.
comfortNotes.photoFirst: You can accept more structure or volume for photos, but still leave a realistic changing and return-time buffer.

HanbokMatcher.freeBoundaryText: It combines only the choices you made above with deterministic rules. No AI model, profile inference or external data transfer is used.
HanbokMatcher.paidBoundaryText: If premium visual try-on or AI styling is added later, its fixed credit cost and photo/privacy terms will be shown before you confirm.
